news.headline: Sebi issues final order against Axis Capital, imposes regulatory censure; Axis Bank shares fall over 1%
news.summary: SEBI has issued a regulatory censure against Axis Capital, concluding proceedings linked to September 2024 restrictions. The regulator noted no recorded investor harm or fraudulent default, while Axis Bank expects no material business impact.

news.headline: Turnaround Story: 8 stocks shift from loss to profit in September '26 quarter
news.summary: Eight Nifty 500 stocks, including IndusInd Bank, Tata Motors and Delhivery, moved from losses to profits in the September 2026 quarter, according to StockEdge's profitability scan.

news.headline: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
news.summary: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) on Friday reported a 41% year-on-year (YoY) growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 18,165 crore in the corresponding period last year.

news.headline: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale
news.summary: Bank of Baroda reported 36% year-on-year profit growth to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27, boosted by NSE stake sale gains and higher interest income. The lender raised annual credit and deposit growth guidance amid strong loan demand.

news.headline: F&O Talk: Big break above 23,200 can open doors for 23,500 for Nifty; Sudeep Shah picks 6 stocks ahead of Diwali
news.summary: Nifty could extend its recovery towards 23,500 if it decisively breaks above the 23,150–23,200 resistance zone, says SBI Securities' Sudeep Shah. He also shares his outlook on IT, midcap and smallcap indices, sector trends and six stocks, including TVS Motor, Coforge and ICICI Bank, ahead of Diwali.

news.headline: IPO ahead: Value-fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail gets Sebi nod to raise funds through public issue
news.summary: Ratnadeep Retail has received Sebi approval to launch an IPO comprising a fresh issue of up to Rs 400 crore and an offer for sale of 1.49 crore shares. The Hyderabad-based retailer plans to use part of the proceeds to repay borrowings and expand its store network across India.

news.headline: Bank of Baroda's Q2 profit surges 36% YoY on NSE stake sale
news.summary: In a remarkable financial performance, Bank of Baroda reported a staggering 36% rise in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹6,532 crore. This surge was propelled by significant non-interest income, recoveries from previously written-off accounts, and gains from the partial sale of its stake in the National Stock Exchange.

news.headline: Sun Pharma Q2 profit takes a hit on exceptional items
news.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical has seen a notable 36% drop in net profit, juxtaposed with an 11.8% rise in consolidated revenue. The uplift in revenue can be attributed largely to strong sales growth in India and emerging markets, particularly in domestic formulations. Conversely, US formulation sales faced a significant downturn. The company also marked progress in its integration planning for the acquisition of Organon, following the successful completion of regulatory approvals.

news.headline: Record earnings! 5 big takeaways from RIL Q2 results investors should watch for Monday trading
news.summary: Reliance Industries reported record Q2FY27 profit of Rs 29,550 crore and revenue of Rs 3.62 lakh crore, driven by strong refining margins and Jio growth. Retail profitability weakened, while declining debt improved the conglomerate's financial position.

news.headline: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: Revenue up 6%, but late festive season, digital spends hit profit
news.summary: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: The company's gross revenue increased 6.4% YoY to Rs 91,716 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 86,169 crore in the year-ago period. The growth came despite the absence of major festive occasions during the quarter, with the festive calendar shifting to the December quarter.

news.headline: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 6,532 crore; NII up 9%
news.summary: Bank of Baroda reported a 35.8% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27. Net interest income grew 9% to Rs 13,026 crore, while asset quality improved, with the gross NPA ratio declining to 1.78%. Global advances and deposits also recorded double-digit growth.

news.headline: Coforge among 6 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 20% in a month
news.summary: Six BSE 200 stocks, including Coforge, Indian Hotels and Kotak Mahindra Bank, hit fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex rallied, with monthly gains reaching 17%.

news.headline: Reliance Industries Q2 Results 2026 Live: RIL Q2 profit jumps 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore; co posts highest-ever quarterly revenue; Jio ARPU rises to Rs 218.8
NTPC Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 5,320 crore; revenue up 17%
news.summary: NTPC has showcased a strong performance in the second quarter of FY27, with a significant 14% increase in standalone net profit year-on-year. The operational revenue saw a notable rise of 16.8% from the same quarter last year, reflecting solid financial health. An interim dividend of Rs 3 per share was announced for shareholders. In a move to bolster growth, NTPC is also increasing its capital expenditure on pumped storage initiatives.

news.headline: Oil-to-chemicals business powers Reliance Industries' record quarterly net profit, up 34% to ₹29,550 crore
news.summary: Reliance Industries Ltd has set a new benchmark with a record net profit of ₹29,550 crore for the September quarter, fueled by significant advancements in the oil-to-chemicals and digital segments. With a yearly revenue surge of 28.5% to ₹3.38 lakh crore, the O2C division's Ebitda skyrocketed 68%, reflecting the advantages of elevated energy prices and the firm’s adaptability in challenging market scenarios.
